<thought>To locate the appropriate Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that, in the forward direction, form a carbon‑carbon double bond (C=C) and an aliphatic carboxylic acid while breaking a carbon‑phosphorus (C‑P) bond and a carbon‑oxygen (C‑O) bond. I will use a simple molecule that contains the relevant functional groups (acrylic acid) as the target SMILES so the search can return templates matching these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["carboxylic acid", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
